content:
maya: Heads-up: ap-south-1 queue depth for model `text-gen-small` jumped to ~1.2k (prefetch queue), median latency 2.4s, p95 6.1s, error rate up 1.8% in the last 15m. @ankur can you check routing / noisy tenants? :warning:

ops-bot: ALERT: queue-depth threshold (800) exceeded for model=text-gen-small region=ap-south-1 metric=queue_depth value=1234

ankur: Investigating. Pulling traces now — looks like a sustained fanout from customer summit-ai across 20k small requests/min. Might be bypassing client backoff.

leo: Summit-ai sent a config change this morning to move to streaming mode, which multiplied connections. Traffic signature matches. Any immediate throttles we can apply?

sara: Short-term mitigation: enable per-client admission control + soft rate limits for summit-ai to 40 rps, and flip fallback routing to `text-gen-small-quant` (lower GPU memory) inside the same region if possible. Also enable prefix caching for repeated prompts.

ankur: Cross-region spill looks blocked by ACLs atm (ap-south -> us-east). Also cost-wise we should avoid cross-region until we triage. Can we enable spillover to the low-priority local pool `dedicated-burst-aps1` and mark requests as low-priority so they get preempted first?

maya: Yes — we have a spare preemptible pool. Propose: (1) set client soft-quota 200k tokens/hr, (2) route overflow to `dedicated-burst-aps1` with admission policy priority=low, (3) enable immediate rate-limit on summit-ai agent. This keeps within region and avoids egress.

leo: Command to set admission policy via admin API (will run with canary 5%):

```
# set admission policy for client
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood.local/v1/admission" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"client_id":"summit-ai","region":"ap-south-1","limit_rps":40,"overflow_pool":"dedicated-burst-aps1","priority":"low","canary":0.05}'
```

ops-bot: ACTION: admission policy change queued — awaiting manual confirmation from @ankur

eileen: Quick cost note: if we end up spilling into us-east for a sustained hour, estimated egress + instance cost ~ $1.2k for that hour. Keeping traffic in-region reduces cost and latency.

sara: I'll message CS to ask summit-ai to apply exponential backoff on their SDK. Also creating a short-lived rate-limit on their api-key and will post the affected keys. @maya please create a dashboard widget for the new policy. :white_check_mark:

ankur: Applying the admission policy now (canary=5% -> 100% after 2m). ETA ~2m.

ops-bot: DEPLOY: admission policy applied for client=summit-ai canary=0.05 by ankur at 1831234578

ankur: Increasing canary to 100% now.

ops-bot: DEPLOY: admission policy canary -> 1.0 by ankur at 1831234585

maya: Post-change checks: queue depth dropping to ~450, median latency 1.1s, error rate stable. Still watching for secondary bursts.

ankur: Closing loop: summit-ai notified, CS follow-up open (#CS-789). Will keep `dedicated-burst-aps1` on standby for 1h.

leo: Nice job. Follow-up items: (1) investigate why SDK switch causes 3x fanout, (2) consider auto-detect of streaming-mode spikes for next quarter.

ops-bot: THREAD ACTIONS: owners={ankur,sara,maya}, incident_ticket=INC-2026-1831
